Ensure diversity by covering various comedy styles (e.g., romantic comedies, buddy films, or mockumentaries) and tones (e.g., silly, sarcastic, or heartfelt). Diversify the reviewer’s voice (e.g., sarcastic critic, enthusiastic fan, or witty commentator) and include references to different cultural or demographic humor to broaden the scope.
